zh.book:
有的人觉得自己是多余的，饭吃不吃都行，明天来不来也无所谓。有的人看上去什么都有，其实一样也带不走，只能拼命把所有事都扛在自己身上。

这两个人碰到了一起，身边又慢慢凑过来几个同样不太会过日子的人。

故事发生在一个冬天。大人们的世界在一点一点往下塌：楼卖不动了，门关上了，嘴上说着“为你好”的人，伸手来要东西。几个半大的孩子就在这片塌方里，用很笨的办法给自己搭了一个能躲雪的地方：一间开着电暖器的屋子，一锅有人等着的饭，一群完全不讲道理的猫。

读的时候我常常笑出声。吵架，偷吃，最认真的话总被一句玩笑岔开。可笑着笑着就会发现，书里几乎每个人都在扛着点什么，也都不太会说。他们关心人的方式都很别扭：不问，只是多留一份饭；不劝，只是一把把你的电脑合上。

它想说的也许很简单：一个人不必先变好，才值得被留下来。快乐可能真的很难学，但总有人愿意陪你慢慢学，学不会也不要紧。

雪会化的。只是化的那段时间，最好身边有人。
chapters: 他本来只想混过这一周。直到有人对他说：祝你以后一切都好。
一道函数题，换一个游戏链接，听起来很公平。可她住的地方，比他想的要低。
一个两年没人租的二楼，一只赶不走的橘猫，还有一条得写在墙上的规矩。
猫有了名字，窗户有了窗帘。桌上多了一把钥匙，她很久都没伸手。
从第一只猫上楼，到最后一个章盖完，一共五天。中间还有一部让他吐了的动画。
开张第一天，一上午没人来。后来终于来了一个，她问：怎么问猫愿不愿意？
一块铁板，一块白板，一段五十万人看过的视频。认出他的人越来越多，他开始躲镜头。
一张值日表，一个从建材市场赶来的父亲。后街拐角那一架，没有电视里打得好看。
一个装满“正常东西”的硬盘，一桌没人吃的过期面包，一张贴在公告栏上的排名。有人想让她正常一点，有人想先让她吃上一口饭。
县城几十年没见过的雪，一件一百二码的粉红羽绒服，还有一个叫她“融融”的阿姨。
半夜醒来的水草缸，一张乒乓球台大的沙盘，一桌茅台。他终于看懂了，却什么都没说。
一只四斤重的螃蟹，两只要找地方过冬的蜘蛛，一锅糖色刚好的红烧肉。还有一巴掌，打在手背上，不重，但是很响。
一碗演给全班看的鸡汤，一张挨着煤炉的折叠床，一个忽然安静下来的冬天。
一罐“做菜用”的啤酒，一台放在门口就走的冰箱，一栋有三张床的小木楼。还有一扇在身后关上的门。
一碗坨了的泡面，一只吃满三根就得躲的年糕，一份凌晨十二点五十八分发来的测试记录。
九场面试，一张写错名字的奖状，一部拔了线的座机。还有屋顶上一只找不到家的蜜蜂。
一个叫黄英俊的新人，一间挂着"以和为贵"的调解室，一张蓝色的银行卡。年糕的犯罪记录又长了一行。
四大袋空饮料瓶，一张贴在灶房墙上的地狱图，一盒照奶奶的方子腌的辣白菜。还有一个被七只猫埋起来的人。
一本被没收的费曼，一个在厕所里收钱的补课老师，一只装在编织袋里进城的老母鸡。还有一碗终于能堂食的骨头汤面。

cast.line: 他妹妹，读初三。鼻子很灵，一闻就知道哥哥去过哪儿。

cast.line: 七班的，帽子总戴歪。开学第一天就和半个班称兄道弟。

cast.name: 王教官
cast.line: 去年刚退伍，带新生很较真。第一天就让三个人进了校医室。

en.book:
Some people feel they’re surplus: whether they eat doesn’t matter, whether they turn up tomorrow doesn’t matter either. Some people seem to have everything, yet can’t take any of it with them, so they end up carrying every last thing on their own shoulders.

These two ran into each other, and slowly a few more gathered round them, people who weren’t much good at getting through life either.

The story takes place over one winter. The grown-ups’ world is caving in, bit by bit: the flats won’t sell, doors are shut, and the people who say “it’s for your own good” are holding out their hands for something. In the middle of the collapse, a few half-grown kids, in the clumsiest possible way, build themselves somewhere to shelter from the snow: a room with an electric heater on, a pot of food someone is waiting for, a pack of utterly unreasonable cats.

I laughed out loud a lot while reading it. Rows, stolen food, the most serious things always derailed by a joke. But somewhere in the laughing you notice that almost everyone in it is carrying something, and none of them is any good at saying so. The way they care for each other is always awkward: they don’t ask, they just save you a portion; they don’t lecture, they just slam your laptop shut.

What it wants to say may be very simple: you don’t have to get better first to deserve being kept. Happiness may really be hard to learn, but someone will always be willing to learn it slowly alongside you, and if you never quite learn it, that’s all right too.

Snow melts. It’s just that while it’s melting, it’s best to have someone beside you.
chapters: He only meant to coast through the week. Then someone told him: I hope everything goes well for you.
A maths lesson in exchange for a game link sounds like a fair deal. But where she lives is lower than he imagined.
A second floor nobody has rented in two years, a ginger cat that won’t leave, and a rule that has to go on the wall.
The cats get names, the windows get curtains. And there is a key on the table that she takes a long time to reach for.
Five days from the first cat upstairs to the last official stamp. Somewhere in the middle, an anime that makes him throw up.
Opening day, and nobody comes all morning. Then someone finally does, and asks: how do you ask a cat?
An iron griddle, a whiteboard, and a video half a million people watched. More and more people recognise him, and he starts dodging cameras.
A cleaning rota, and a father who comes straight from the building-materials market. The fight at the corner of Back Street looks nothing like the ones on TV.
A hard drive full of “normal stuff,” an out-of-date bun left in a desk, and a ranking pinned up in the hall. Someone wants her to be a bit more normal; someone else just wants her to eat.
The heaviest snow the county town has seen in decades, a pink down jacket in a child’s size 120, and an auntie who calls her “Rongrong.”
An aquarium at two in the morning, a sand table the size of a ping-pong table, a dinner with a case of Moutai. He finally understands, and says nothing.
A crab weighing two kilos, two spiders that need somewhere warm for the winter, a pot of braised pork with the caramel just right. And one slap on the back of a hand: not hard, but very loud.
A bowl of chicken soup served for an audience, a folding bed next to a coal stove, and a winter that suddenly goes quiet.
A can of beer that is “for cooking,” a fridge left at a door by someone who doesn’t stay, a little wooden house with three beds. And a door that closes behind him.
A bowl of soggy instant noodles, a Rice Cake that has to start dodging after its third treat, and a bug report sent at 12:58 in the morning.
Nine interviews, a certificate with the name written wrong, a landline with its cord pulled out. And a bee on a roof that can’t find its way home.
A new recruit called Huang Yingjun, a mediation room under a sign that says “Harmony is most precious,” and a blue bank card. Rice Cake’s criminal record gets one line longer.
Four big bags of empty drink bottles, a picture of hell on a kitchen wall, a box of spicy cabbage made to Grandma’s recipe. And one person buried under seven cats.
A confiscated Feynman, a tutor who takes his money in the toilets, an old hen riding into town in a woven sack. And a bowl of bone-broth noodles you can finally eat in.

cast.name: Ye Zhixing
cast.line: A demerit before term has even started. Blunt, and his shoelace came undone on every lap.

cast.name: Gu Xuerong
cast.line: Cuffs always buttoned to the wrist. Seventh on the whole server, stuck on a quadratic.

cast.name: Lin Xiaoman
cast.line: Gu Xuerong’s roommate. Round face, short hair, always saves her a plate of dinner.

cast.name: Ye Zhixia
cast.line: His sister, in her last year of middle school. One sniff and she knows where her brother has been.

cast.name: Chen Xi
cast.line: Class Seven, cap always crooked. Best friends with half the class by the end of day one.

cast.name: Instructor Wang
cast.line: Out of the army only a year and very serious about it. Three people in the clinic on day one.
